newsitem.title: USA: Komag sees Q4 EPS below $0.72/shr.
newsitem.headline: Komag sees Q4 EPS below $0.72/shr.

text.p: Komag Inc said it believes that fourth quarter sales will surpass the sales in the recently completed third quarter as well as the $152 million achieved in the first and second quarters of 1996.
Komag said its fourth quarter net should top its third, but will be below the year ago fourth quarter's $0.72 a share.

It said the earnings contribution from Asahi Komag Co., Ltd. (AKCL), its unconsolidated Japanese joint venture, should remain at a low level for the fourth quarter. It said AKCL will likely operate at less than full capacity during the fourth quarter.

It said that even though Komag's second half performance will be below its record-setting first half performance, fiscal 1996 financial results should still compare favorably to those for fiscal 1995.
Komag reported third quarter earnings of $.31 a share versus $0.61 a share a year ago.

In the third quarter, the company's equity in AKCL's net income contributed about $0.01 per share to Komag's earnings, compared to about $0.06 in the third quarter of 1995 and $0.09 per share in the second quarter of 1996. This reduced earnings contribution was due in large part to the writedown of AKCL's remaining investment in Headway Technologies, Inc., a manufacturer of MR recording heads.
